description: v2 red lava GOO (artist 2026-09-26: 'red lava instead of rock with lava in it, more lava blob monster'). The whole body is molten, so every goo region glows; the glow tiers grade heat across the goo: cooler crimson undersides, hot red-orange body, orange flow patches and ridges, yellow flame tips (crown points, torn-end tufts, head flame licks, drips), white-hot yellow core at every torn end (the join faces) and on the droplets, glowing eye rings with dark pupils. Colours authored fresh: the source blend carries no material.

goo_cool.note: undersides (smoothed normal pointing down): cooler crimson goo

goo.note: the body: hot red lava slime

goo_hot.note: hotter orange flow patches (smooth mottling) + ridges

flame.note: flame tips: head flame licks, crown points, torn-end tufts, drip bulbs, finger tips; the ring round each torn end

core.note: white-hot molten core: the torn (join) end faces, the crater, the floating droplets

pupil.note: dark dot pupils (no glow: the sketch's dot eyes read by contrast)
